Part.name: Nizh panel
Part.description: Nizh panel - modular Nozh panel (game proxy) Resize X/Z to add whole cells (1x1 up to 8x8): 125 x 250 mm per cell, 46.5 mm deep. Each cell has its own 8 mm steel front plate over one 36 mm Nozh layer (linear shaped charges) and spends independently. Plates: 1 | Layers: 1 Effective angles: 30-70° (best APFSDS) Kinetic (APFSDS) at 60°: 20% less pen. Chemical (HEAT) at 60°: 55% less pen. Tandem: no guaranteed protection Extra loss, reference L/D 30 Mass and cost scale with paid cell area only, never depth
